bear_assumptions: About USD 24 billion of normalized forward revenue at roughly 25x enterprise value/revenue as AI contracts prove concentrated or low-margin, Starlink ARPU pressure persists, Starship milestones slip, capex remains far above operating cash flow, and dilution continues.
base_assumptions: About USD 32 billion of forward revenue at roughly 43x enterprise value/revenue as Connectivity sustains strong profit, AI infrastructure scales with only gradual margin improvement, Space remains investment-heavy, and net cash plus dilution are broadly contained.
bull_assumptions: About USD 45 billion of forward revenue at roughly 56x enterprise value/revenue as Starlink subscriber and enterprise growth stays exceptional, AI contracts broaden with improving margins, Starship de-risks, and the combined platform earns a persistent scarcity premium.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh primary evidence and a revised scenario set clear expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade if Connectivity loses operating leverage, ARPU or churn overwhelms subscriber growth, AI remains structurally loss-making after scale, Starship milestones slip without a credible path, capex fails to improve unit economics, customer concentration worsens, dilution accelerates, or governance and related-party decisions transfer value from Class A shareholders.
